content: Atɔŋ, mɛ ŋakwo, mpal kàyi mɛ akà bɛ, kà yàkäl anki anà uyɔl a ndaa, itàkal an'yeerà mukàlakyään ngyee a Nzam.
Ntɔn mɛ kàtsül mukɔɔn ayöb undiir mwɛy uboo a bɛ, isàkɔɔn akal Yɛsu Klistɔ, anà Yɛsu Klistɔ awà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Lalan kàkäl mɛ sye wàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là anà wàbɔɔmà anà wàŋàtɛɛr kusà a bɛ:
ndaa amɛ anà an'lɔɔŋ amɛ màkäl anki anà undiir mwɛy wàntwetweey aŋàsà kam, wɛɛ màkäl muswaŋ isal a ngwal anà kyà Dweelà,
ntɔn làkwikilà abɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n akal udu a an'yeerà a baar, wɛɛ udu a ngwal a Nzam.
Apanà sye, bi ifàlɔŋ an'yeerà mwɛy akà baar aŋàtsim, an'yeerà mpa amà mà mɛɛn mà, itàkal mà ntwasà a mɛɛn mà, abà bàsàyaalà.
Wɛɛ, bi ifàlɔŋ an'yeerà a Nzam màŋàyee akà baar, amà kàyöŋà Nzam itaan kusà a nkyeer ntɔn làkoo abi.
Akà ntwasà mwɛy wà mɛɛn mà kàyöb anki ma, ntɔn ba bàlàyöb ma, ba Mwol a làkoo bulun'bɛɛrà anki u kulunsi.

content.text: « Indiir mpa kàmɛn dii anà mpa kàwem tsü,
indiir mpa kàyweer mbuur u mpem,
indiir kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n Nzam ntɔn baar bàfun'kwen. »

content: Abun, Nzam wa kà imɛɛy u mbwo a Dweelà. Ntɔn Dweelà afàgyool indiir byanswà, itàkal indiir a ngyɛlàngyɛl a Nzam.
Nà uboo a baar kan'kwo muyöb indiir abyà uboo a mbuur, naa tɛy dweelà alà uboo ande ŋakwo? Ifà imwɛy sye, indiir abyà amu Nzam, akà mbuur mwɛy uyöb anki, naa tɛy Dweelà a Nzam.
Akà bi, bi kàwɛl anki dweelà a mɛɛn, wɛɛ Dweelà afàfà akà Nzam, ntɔn bi iyöb an'kab a kab a ngway a Nzam.
Waa bi indiir abi sye ifàtɛn anki unsà ndaa ifàlɔŋ an'yeerà a mbuur, wɛɛ unsà ndaa ufàlɔŋ Dweelà a Nzam, mutɛn indiir a Dweelà unsà ngɔk ufàpà Dweelà.
Ntsür a mbuur ufàwal anki indiir ifàfà akà Dweelà a Nzam. Bya byà ukɔŋ ntɔn nde, nde ukwe anki muyöb bya, ntɔn bya bàfàyöb unsà Dweelà.
Kyekà, mbuur awe anà Dweelà afàsyeebà indiir byanswà, nde ŋakwo mbuur mwɛy tɛy kan'kwo mukun'syeebà.
Kyekà bi, bi ibye anà an'kyän a Klistɔ.
